These are descriptive diagnostics, not a human relevance score. Matching material is partly built into the strategic features. Similar engine evaluations alone do not imply similar plans. Fixed-budget Stockfish annotations are approximate.

Sampling, model inputs and evaluation protocol

Up to six target-to-move positions per game, sampled between plies 24 and 100. The strategic method uses 89 current-position features. The neural method uses frozen Maia-3 pooled square tokens with previous legal position history, reduced to 64 dimensions. The chosen move and future moves are excluded. Scaling and PCA are fitted only on training games.

Diagnostics use one query per test game and training references, excluding the same game, exact/mirrored transpositions, and matching exact ECO codes. The 100 blinded trials have distinct query games: 20 for development and 80 reserved for a final audit. Audit responses should be collected independently after freezing the method. Human results are pending; no superiority claim is made.

Boards retain their actual piece colors, with the side to move at the bottom. Facts refer to the sampled starting position. Continuations show the historical moves, not an engine-generated plan. Original collection licensing and pretrained-data overlap remain uncertain.
